results.name: Petit parisien Gainsbourg Sandwich
results.description:
I just discovered [Le Petit Parisien](https://www.lepetitparisienusa.com/), who delivers French sandwiches in NYC.

I have high sandwich expectations, and was not disappointed! Pleasantly surprised actually, super good bread, great hamd, great comté, and cornichons on top. Well crafted.

Scanned with 100 pics shot with iPhone and processed with Metashape.

results.name: Beef Sandwich
results.description:
A tasty slow cooked beef brisquet sandwich. 

A photogrammetry scan using 200 photos. Highly detail and accurate. 

This model captures all the deliciousness of this sandwich.

Most importantly, it tasted as good as it looks.
